title.zh: 将朗布隆省奥迪翁甘市镇的Romblon国立中学奥迪翁甘分校更名为Odiongan国立中学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Romblon National High School-Odiongan in the Municipality of Odiongan, Province of Romblon to Odiongan National High School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Romblon National High School-Odiongan in the Municipality of Odiongan, Province of Romblon to Odiongan National High School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Romblon National High School-Odiongan tại Thị trấn Odiongan, Tỉnh Romblon thành Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Odiongan
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ Romblon National High School-Odiongan ในเทศบาล Odiongan, จังหวัด Romblon เป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Odiongan
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Romblon National High School-Odiongan di Kotamadya Odiongan, Provinsi Romblon menjadi Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Odiongan
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Romblon National High School-Odiongan di Perbandaran Odiongan, Wilayah Romblon menjadi Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Odiongan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2012/ra_10333_2012.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Renaming of a National High School. – The name of Romblon National High School - Odiongan in the Municipality of Odiongan, Province of Romblon is hereby changed to Odiongan National High School.
Location of the Main Campus. - The main campus of the Odiongan National High School shall continue to remain in its present location in the Municipality of Odiongan, Province of Romblon.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
